subject.title: fix(googlechat): keep off-mode replies out of threads

question: Should this PR wait for a current-head live Google Chat run, or is the credential gap acceptable given the clean contract review, Testbox coverage, and related prior live evidence?
rationale: The code and tests support correctness, but only a maintainer can accept merging a user-visible message-routing change without observing this exact head in a real Google Chat space.

options.title: Require current-head live proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted evidence shows default/off replies remain top-level and all-mode replies remain in-thread on the exact head.

options.title: Accept the provider-proof gap
options.body: Merge based on the source contract, focused and broad Testbox coverage, and related prior live Google Chat evidence.

recommendation.title: Require current-head live proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted evidence shows default/off replies remain top-level and all-mode replies remain in-thread on the exact head.
